_note: The palettes the design system is RUN against: tests/design-system.spec.js renders /design-system under every one of them, and scripts/build-design-system.js computes each one's token values with tokens() (api/_shared/brand-workspace-core.js) for design/lifecycle-os/tokens.json and the Design System artifact's themes. Tenant zero's palette is READ from data/brands/_default.json at build time, never copied here. Every other palette is a stress case defined for the gate (NEW, 2026-10-05), not any company's record.

palettes.name: Lifecycle OS neutral
palettes.why: The platform's own colours (the mark's ink and tile, assets/lifecycle-os-mark.svg) run through the same contract, so the system has a face that is nobody's brand. No page ships this palette; it is what tokens() derives from the mark's neutrals.

palettes.name: Example brand (tenant zero)
palettes.why: The shipped default record. Read from data/brands/_default.json; this is also what theme.css falls back to when no brand is active (the BRAND-SYNC block).

palettes.name: Red primary, deep brown accent
palettes.why: The shape of the operator's 2026-10-05 report (/studio with a red-primary brand active: red bands, dark brown panels, unreadable cards). Synthetic values, not that brand's record. A deep brown is a brand colour, not a neutral, so it may be a band.

palettes.name: Pale primary and accent
palettes.why: Light brand colours that are invisible as raw text on white, light state colours, and a muted grey that fails on its own: every text token has to be derived. The contrast-rendered gate's HOSTILE palette plus light state colours.

palettes.name: Near-black primary
palettes.why: A brand whose primary and accent are dark neutrals. Its buttons may be near-black (a control); no SECTION may be: --brand-band falls through to the surface.

palettes.name: Bare brand (no palette)
palettes.why: A record with no colours at all. tokens() fills it from its own fallbacks; a bare record cannot be ACTIVATED (validatePalette), but it is painted while a draft is being built.
